newsitem.title: UK: BOE TO COMMISSION REPORT ON WINDFALL PAYMENTS.
newsitem.headline: BOE TO COMMISSION REPORT ON WINDFALL PAYMENTS.

text.p: The Bank of England will commission a special report on the effect of windfall payments from converting building societies, deputy governor Mervyn King said on Wednesday.

"The Bank will commission a special survey on the effect of windfall payments," King said in a news conference covering the Bank's quarterly inflation report. "It should be available in a month or so."
King said the Bank estimated those windfalls totalled 36 billion stg.
